name: Soloi Brahe
source:
About 35 years old.
Affiliation: Temple
Hobby: Deciphering Ancient Manuscripts
Special Skill: Dancing
Likes: Helpful Things
Dislikes: Unhelpful Things

A head priest who runs the Magic Institution and Knight School.
He is also a skilled swordsman and magician and it's said that if you see his skill you will surely die.
He's extremely loyal towards [url=/c46990]Pluto[/url], but he has no mercy for incompetent people or criminals.
